title: MetaNFT
tagline: MetaNFT is a fully community driven, 100% fair release NFT marketplace and DeFi community. Reflex, Auto LP and Burn.
description: MetaNFT is a fully community driven, 100% fair release NFT marketplace and DeFi community. Reflex, Auto LP and Burn. 50% of the total supply (500 trillion) has been sent to the black hole address (0x0000*dead) No token sale, 100% of the circulating supply (500 trillion) is listed directly to pancakeswap v2 10% fee per transaction, 2.5 % will be redistributed to all current holders, 2.5% will be sent to the black hole address and 5% will be burned to automatically increase the liquidity pool.
how_its_made: We used Github for project output. It is our first time to do such project, it is very challenging for us. We hope we could make a better project next time. Thank you for the chance. Our project: https://github.com/kc-keung/MetaNFT you may find out the source of it through this link.
